fieldValues.title: How images enter an essay
fieldValues.decision_question: By what route may an image appear in an essay?
fieldValues.context: The owner, 2026-11-08 (vignettes debafe21, 02e02668): 'An essay without images may be handicapped' and 'We would need to add a special type of paragraph that does images.' Decision c7d81c5d (ratified 2026-11-06) kept images out of the visual editor and names 'writers ask for images' as its revisit trigger; this decision answers that trigger without changing its allowlist. Precedent consulted: abed4266 (the essay package can grow basic building blocks for structured writing); the quotation type, a second record type already placed in essays; vignette 19964824 (the essay's structure comes from typed paragraphs, not rich text). Problem SP-164 (fff6809b), remedy fd1b4728.
fieldValues.friction: Today the only route is a markdown image from a remote URL, which the essay does not own and the visual editor cannot edit.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
A. A dedicated image paragraph type (owner's ruling; recommended). For: structure carried by a type, as everywhere else in SRS; caption, alt text and layout become fields; the visual editor's allowlist stays short. Against: one more type in the essay package and its upgrade.
B. Inline markdown images resolved to attachments. For: images inside text. Against: needs a new reference scheme and an RFC; layout and caption leak into markup.
C. Leave it: markdown images from remote URLs. For: no work. Against: link rot, reader tracking, not stored with the essay.
D. No images. Against: the owner's own word, handicapped.
fieldValues.key_requirements: The image is owned by the essay; layout and caption are structured; the writer's text stays plain markdown; adding it later to other editors stays possible.
fieldValues.decision_statement: An image appears in an essay only as its own image paragraph, never inside the text of a normal paragraph.
fieldValues.rationale: A typed paragraph keeps structure in types, which is how SRS avoids rich text, and gives caption, alt text and layout a home as fields. The owner ruled it.
fieldValues.revisit_when: Writers ask for images inside running text, or for wrap, often enough that the image paragraph gets in the way.
